content: Bwisi yi Lemuɛli, Mɑsɑn sinɑ boko u wɑ sɑɑ win mɛron min di. U nɛɛ,
nɛn bii, wunɛ wi nɑ yiirɑ nɑ mɑrɑ, ɑ mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio. Wunɛ wi nɑ kɑnɑ nɛn kɑnɑru sɔɔ, ɑ swɑɑ tem kpĩiyɔ ɑ nɔ.
A ku de tɔn kurɔbu bu wunɛn dɑm kpe. A ku de tɔn kurɔ be bɑ sinɑmbu kɑm koosiɑ bu nun dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ tie.
Lemuɛli, ɑ de ɑ n yeni yɛ̃. N ǹ weenɛ sinɑmbu bu tɑm nɔ. N ǹ weenɛ wiruɡibu bu tɑm bɔɔbɔm kɑsu.
Domi bɑ̀ n mu nɔrɑ, mu koo bu ɡo kpɑ bu duɑri bu woodɑ swĩi, kpɑ bu sɑ̃ɑrobu ɡem birɑ.
I be bɑ ɡɔɔ dɔɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu tɑm bɔɔbɔm wɛ̃ɛyɔ bu nɔ.
Bɑ̀ n nɔrɑ kpɑ bu ben sɑ̃ɑru kɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru duɑri.
Adɑmɑ wunɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ be bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu ɡɑri ɡere yɔ̃rɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ be bɑ ǹ somiɔ mɔ.
A kɑ bu yinɔ kpɑ ɑ bu siriɑ dee dee. A kɑ wɔnwɔndobu kɑ sere mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu yinɔ.
Kurɔ ɡeon dɑɑ
Kurɔ ɡeon wɑɑbu bu ǹ sɛ̃? Domi win bɛɛrɛ yɑ wurɑbɑ kere.
Win durɔ rɑ n nùn nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑwɑ, u ǹ sɑ̃ɑru wɑsi.
Win wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃nu kpuro sɔɔ, ɡeɑ u rɑ win durɔ kue, n ǹ mɔ kɔ̃sɑ.
U rɑ wɛ̃su kɑsu u tɑri. U rɑ n nɔmɑn sɔmburu mɔ̀ kɑ nuku tiɑ.
U rɑ win dĩɑnu wɑɑmɛwɑ sɑɑ mi n tomɑn di nɡe ɡoo nimkuu ɡe ɡɑ tenkuru mɔ̀.
U rɑ sewɑ sɑɑ mìn di yɑm kun sɑ̃rɑm kpɑ, u kɑ win yɛnuɡibu dĩɑnu kuɑ, kpɑ u win wɔndiɑbɑ sɔmɑ bɔnu kuɑ.
U koo tem kɑsu u dwe u kɑrɑ ko, kpɑ u kɑ win tiin kiɑrun ɑre resɛm dɑ̃ɑ binu dwe u duure mi, ni nu koo mɑ.
U rɑ win sɔmburu kowɑ kɑ dɑm. U ku rɑ wɛ̃re.
Ye u mɔ̀ kpuro u rɑ n yen ɑrufɑɑni yɛ̃. U rɑ n sɔmburu mɔ̀ sere kɑ wɔ̃kurɔ.
U rɑ n tɑrimɔ.
U rɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu kɛ̃ru wɛ̃.
U ǹ woorun sɑɑn bɛrum mɔ win yɛnuɡibun sɔ̃ domi be kpuro bɑ woorun yɑbenu mɔ win sɔmburun sɔ̃.
Wiyɑ rɑ yɑ̃nu doke ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ beku nɔniɡinu, kpɑ u mɑɑ kpin yenun bekunu ko.
Bɑ rɑ win durɔ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ ù n sinɑ kɑ wuun ɡuro ɡurobu sɑnnu.
U rɑ yɑbenu kɑ sɛ̃kɑtii ko u tenkubɑ dɔre.
Dɑm kɑ bɛɛrɛwɑ u rɑ n sebuɑ nɡe yɑberu. U ku rɑ wurure siɑn bukɑtɑn sɔ̃.
Lɑɑkɑri sɔɔrɑ u rɑ nɔɔ wukie, kpɑ u n tɔmbu bwisi kɛ̃mɔ kɑ kĩru.
U rɑ win yɛnu nɔni dokewɑ kpɑ u n yɛ̃ ye yɑ koorɑmɔ ɡe sɔɔ. U ǹ yikuru mɔ.
Win bibɑ rɑ nùn siɑre, kɑ win durɔn tii, kpɑ durɔ u n mɔ̀,
kurɔ dɑbinu bɑ sɑ̃ɑ kurɔ ɡeebu, ɑdɑmɑ wunɑ ɑ kere.
Wɑsin burɑm mu ǹ nɑɑnɛ mɔ, wuswɑɑn burɑm mu rɑ mɑɑ doonɛ, ɑdɑmɑ kurɔ wi u Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsie, wiyɑ bɑ koo siɑrɑ.
I de u win nɔmɑn sɔmburun ɑre wɑ kpɑ bɑɑwure u nùn siɑrɑ ten sɔ̃.
